## History

During a violent hail storm that struck [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), Tommy and his twin sister [Dora](../character/dora.md) rushed home from school alongside [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). Later, he rebelled against Mrs. Lynde's rules by coercing [Dora](../character/dora.md) to skip [Sunday School](../codex/places.md#sunday-school) so they could fish and play with the [Cottons](../codex/factions.md#cottons). ## Relationships

### [Mirabel Cotton](../character/mirabel-cotton.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/mirabel-cotton--tommy.md)

Tommy is the brother of [Mirabel Cotton](../character/mirabel-cotton.md). The two siblings, along with the rest of the Cotton family, participate in playing and going fishing with [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md) after [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) coerces his sister into skipping [Sunday School](../codex/places.md#sunday-school).
